content.question: Why does the Transformer need positional encoding?
options: Because it processes tokens in parallel and has no inherent notion of word order, unlike RNNs or LSTMs.
Because attention heads cannot handle long words.
Because the loss function requires absolute positions to converge.
Because the encoder and decoder must share the same weights.
content.answer: Because it processes tokens in parallel and has no inherent notion of word order, unlike RNNs or LSTMs.
